prologueText: You arrive at the outer perimeter of the Sunken Sun Temple. Weathered wall carvings whisper forgotten lore, while pulsing respawn beacons promise sanctuary amidst ancient fire traps.
title: The Whispering Ruins
author: Ancient Guild of Cartographers

help.title: Chapter 1: The Whispering Ruins
help.message: Inspect wall carvings [E], collect bonus sun gems, activate the respawn beacon, and safely bypass the flame vents.
